about: Fixture set for the overnight draft prompt (overnight-draft@1), from the fictional Riverside engagement. Each case has the inputs overnight_claim hands the worker, the reply recorded for the fake client, and what the draft may and may not contain. The recorded reply is checked against the expectations always, and a real reply too when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set.
